description: Finish the upload with every part's etag. The build is checked (app id, version, whether our devices can run it) and returned. Use the returned build.id in run_test {buildId} or run_project {buildIds} to run the new build. Uploading alone does not start a run. The command from create_build_upload completes the upload itself; call this only after uploading parts to the signed links yourself. Also accepts the signed completeUrl instead of an API key.
name: complete_build_upload
title: Complete a build upload
